items.title: Porepunkah property owner makes new claims about Dezi Freeman incident
items.description: The owner of the Porepunkah property where Dezi Freeman shot two police officers says he rang and spoke to Freeman soon after the shooting.

items.title: Friends witness 'horrific' shark attack that claimed life of spearfishing mate

items.title: Taylor vows to amend Sex Discrimination Act following 'Tickle v Giggle' ruling
items.description: Opposition Leader Angus Taylor has vowed to amend the Sex Discrimination Act after the Federal Court upheld a landmark ruling that the exclusion of a transgender woman from a female-only app was discriminatory.

items.title: Trump says the US and Nigeria have killed second-in-command ISIS leader

items.title: After her husband's death, Annie discovered he had placed 100 bets a day

items.title: Counting underway in Stafford by-election as early results show swing toward LNP

items.title: Amid grief, the NT's CLP rushes drastic child protection changes
